name: Affection
overview: Scripture commands believers to love one another deeply and sincerely, reflecting the love Christ has shown us (John 13:34). This affection is expressed through brotherly love, honoring and preferring one another (Romans 12:10), and fulfilling the law by loving others (Romans 13:8). Loving our neighbors as ourselves is described as the greatest commandment after loving God (Mark 12:31), while believers are called to put away bitterness, anger, and malice that hinder genuine affection (Ephesians 4:31). True affection aligns with holiness, as those who live in sin and idolatry have no inheritance in God's kingdom (Ephesians 5:5).
